items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: So with the Basin Street Six, I primarily was George Girard. I did all the things that he did.

ctx.x: We jump about so much, I keep thinking we're going to forget all those early exciting days. We talked about Shockey and some of the people you listen to. You said you knew Joyce did a lot. You can imitate both of them. Were there any other people who stars you were aware of? Louie was mentioned.

Louie was... Let me explain something to you. My first job, first real job with an organized band that I was not the leader on. All these years, in the beginning, I had always been the leader, the prime mover behind these groups. I would go out and get the guys and call the tunes. And the first band that I didn't do all in was the Basin Street Six. George had left the band. And it was a very tight band. It had many arrangements, most of which were head arrangements. I had followed the band for years. I say years,…
Yeah, that's how I remember it. Don't think I heard it too much. Where was your blank puppet again?
